name: Teen Community Service Program
what_you_do: Join City staff to pack and hand out boxes of food at the Mission Hope food pantry. High school students get community service hours.
who_can_apply: The November session is for ages 14 to 18. The City says the program is for ages 11 to 18, so younger teens should ask about later sessions. The page lists no rule on where you live.
deadline_text: Next session is Monday, Nov 23, 2026. Sign-up closes that day at 9am. Only 20 spots.
how_to_apply: Sign up in the City class catalog. You need an account. Look for Volunteer @ Mission Hope. You must sign up before you go.
notes: Meet at Mission Hope, 41760 Rider Way. Wear clothes that can get dirty and closed-toe shoes. The City also lists service at Rose Haven Heritage Garden, but no date is posted. Questions: Volunteer@TemeculaCA.gov.
